servers.name: memory
servers.description: Persistent gingugu memory: facts, decisions, workflows, and relations in a local SQLite database.

servers.name: filesystem
servers.description: File access within configured dependency, compiler-header, and temporary directories. Customize the example roots for this system; check list_allowed_directories before use.

servers.name: fetch-server
servers.description: Fetch a public URL and extract Markdown, with pagination for long pages.

servers.name: git
servers.description: Inspect and operate on local Git repositories. Pass an explicit repo_path; tools include reads and mutations.

servers.name: context7
servers.description: Library documentation and examples. Resolve a library ID before query-docs; keep credentials out of queries.

servers.name: cocoindex-code
servers.description: Fallback code search after mcpls-lsp: semantic search in an initialized CocoIndex project. Uses LAZY_MCP_PROJECT_ROOT or the daemon launch directory; run ccc init in that project first.

servers.name: mcpls-lsp
servers.description: Primary code search and navigation: workspace symbols, definitions, references, diagnostics, and refactoring through installed language servers. Uses LAZY_MCP_PROJECT_ROOT or the daemon launch directory; check get_tool_support for active languages.
